note: Canonical data store for trending-local-llms. One row per model. Generated README tables are produced from this file by scripts/update_trending.py. Never hand-edit generated tables; update this store (or the template) and regenerate. Engagement + t/s must trace to a real X post (lightbrd mirror) or be marked (est).
